Game Overview

The Last of Survival puts players into a shooter experience centered on enter a relentless battle for survival in a post-apocalyptic world teeming with zombies. Utilize strategic movements and precise aiming to fend off relentless undead hordes. Scavenge vital resources, climb the leaderboard, and become humanity's last hope. Unleash your inner warrior and conquer the apocalypse!
